name: R2R / discrete ladder
_linearization: Manual 4.4: a suitable shaper (LNS15, NS9, NS5) at a high output rate corrects the linearity errors inherent to any R2R ladder, lowering low-level and zero-crossing distortion. A second use of the shaper, distinct from masking noise.
_bits: Author: "it is truly impossible to make one that is linear to 24 bits". Declare the ladder's real depth, 18 to 20 bits, not the interface's.
_dsd_reconverted_to_pcm: Not a family property: Holo converts DSD directly, Denafrips re-converts it to PCM. The record must say.
